title: WNBA player offers to testify vs. Pearce in DV case

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: WNBA player offers to testify vs. Pearce in DV case
sources.description: An attorney for WNBA player Rickea Jackson said she is "willing to testify" against Falcons player James Pearce Jr. if the domestic violence charges against him go to trial.
